criteria.criterion: The new decided-on-main test fails on the base code. The verifier checks this by reading read_snapshot in the base (git show of the base file), where decisions come only from the records tip, and by inspecting that the test's decision is absent from that tip. Run: cargo test -p xtask decisions on the candidate.
criteria.evidence: In the base, read_snapshot fills `decided` only from ls_tree_under(tip, ...) over records/work-items, records/work-decisions and records/roles, where tip is the athena/records tip. The diff adds only the HEAD loop. The test itself asserts that ls_tree_under(tip, "records/work-decisions") is empty. So on the base code the decided set would be empty, both proposals would render as cards, and the assertions `!html.contains(first.id)` and `!html.contains("<article")` would fail. On the candidate the test passes.

findings.summary: The main-tree read swallows every git error, not only the expected 'no HEAD' case
findings.evidence: `.unwrap_or_default()` on ls_tree_under("HEAD", ...) also hides a real git failure, such as a corrupt object or a git that cannot run. The page would then quietly fall back to listing decided proposals, which is the bug this job fixes. ls-tree on a missing path already returns an empty list with exit 0, so only a missing HEAD needs the fallback. A simpler, safer approach: treat only an unresolvable HEAD as empty (check rev-parse --verify HEAD first) and push any other error into `unreadable`.

findings.evidence: The rewrapped doc line is about 160 characters, while the neighbouring lines wrap near 115. rustfmt does not reflow comments, so fmt still passes.

summary: The change fixes the root cause the user named. read_snapshot now also reads WorkDecision records from records/work-decisions/ in main's tree (the checkout's HEAD) and adds them to the set of decided proposals, so approved and rejected proposals no longer appear on the page. The module doc and the CHANGELOG entry both name the cause: decisions are recorded on main, but the page read only athena/records. Two new tests cover the fix. One puts proposals on athena/records and their Approved and Rejected decisions only on main, asserts the records tip holds no decisions, and checks through locate() and render() that no card is shown. The other checks that an undecided proposal is still listed as one card. Reading the base code shows the first test would fail there, because base reads decisions only from the records tip. I ran `cargo test -p xtask decisions` and all 12 tests passed; fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded CI run. All changed files are on the deliverables list; docs/architecture.md was not changed. Its listing is a permission, not a requirement, and the existing docs still say correctly that proposals come from athena/records. Remaining findings: the main-tree read swallows every git error, which could quietly bring back the bug (minor), and one long doc line in site.rs (nit).
